summary: Frontend-only e2e testing for Atelier VENKU site. Verified all 9 requested flows: Home hero+CTA, Top nav (logo+5 items+CZ/EN), language switcher (CZ<->EN updates headline & menu items), Portfolio (6 cards open detail with 5-photo gallery & close), Nabídka 4 process steps + CTA to /kontakt, O ateliéru, Vzdělávání 3 program cards, Kontakt mailto/tel/mocked form (success message with diacritics), and mobile (390x844) responsive (hamburger appears, no horizontal overflow, portfolio becomes 1 column). All flows work. Found ONE data bug: Project 3 gallery references PHOTOS.garden9 which is undefined, causing one broken image (background-image: url("undefined")) in the Brno project gallery.

ui_bugs.issue: Gallery references undefined PHOTOS.garden9 in /app/frontend/src/data/content.js line ~71. Renders one broken image with style background-image: url("undefined"). Confirmed via DOM inspection: 1 element with url('undefined').

action_items: Fix /app/frontend/src/data/content.js: replace 'PHOTOS.garden9' on project id=3 gallery with an existing photo key (e.g., PHOTOS.garden5 or PHOTOS.garden6). Currently produces a broken background-image.
critical_code_review_comments: data/content.js references PHOTOS.garden9 which does not exist in the PHOTOS object — silently produces undefined background-image in project 3 gallery. Add a sanity check or define garden9.
Email anchor uses href=mailto:ahoj@ateliervenku.cz, phone uses tel:+420777123456 (whitespace stripped) — both correct.
Mocked contact form: HTML5 'required' on name+email correctly blocks empty submit; success state 'Děkujeme. Ozveme se vám brzy.' renders with proper Czech diacritics.
EN labels render uppercase due to CSS text-transform; functional translations are correct (Portfolio/Services/About/Education/Contact).
No horizontal overflow on mobile (390px) for Home, Portfolio and Kontakt. Hamburger opens overlay and links navigate.
Portfolio card 4 has class 'wide' but tested fine; click-to-expand and 5-photo gallery work for all cards.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Static React app on https://logo-web-build.preview.emergentagent.com. All data-testids work. Only known issue is the PHOTOS.garden9 undefined reference in project 3's gallery in src/data/content.js. The contact form is intentionally mocked (700ms setTimeout). Czech diacritics render fine throughout.
rca of the issue: Bug: project 3 gallery has broken image. Reproduction: open /portfolio, click portfolio-item-3, observe 2nd gallery tile. RCA: in /app/frontend/src/data/content.js, projects[2].gallery uses PHOTOS.garden9 but PHOTOS only defines garden1..garden8. Mitigation: change PHOTOS.garden9 to an existing key like PHOTOS.garden5 or define a new garden9 photo URL.
